sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Keep spellcasting ability and total character level3. NEW finite recovery interpretation: once per beneficial Long Rest, after your own genuine attack resolves with a kept natural20, recover up to2RP into an existing actual pool, capped by missing RP and an eligible previously paid rank1 spell cost from this same rest epoch. Choose one committed rank1 cast receipt that actually spent RP before this attack and still has at least1unrecovered paid RP. Refund at most the lesser of2, its remaining paid amount and missing pool capacity; mark exactly that paid amount recovered so it cannot fund this feat again or a second refund of the same expense. A discounted1RP cast funds at most1; a free innate cast funds0. You may decline and keep the use; a declaration with no eligible paid receipt or no missing capacity is ineligible.

The qualifying attack may be a weapon or spell attack, including a genuine cantrip attack, but must be yours against a conscious, independently acting actual hostile opponent presenting a real encounter threat. NEW anti-farming exclusions: no object, self, willing training partner, compliant captive, your own controlled/summoned creature, copied/reflected roll or fabricated repeat of a natural20. A legitimate hostile opponent’s immunity does not erase its actual natural20 attack trigger; damage is not a printed requirement. An expanded critical on19, automatic hit, hypothetical die or replaced natural20 that was not kept does not qualify. Companions using your spell attack bonus are still different attackers. Resolve any triggering attack’s consequences first; recovery cannot retroactively pay an unaffordable cast or prevent that event’s death. No spell slot or “ranked recovery” pool is created.

FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual personal spellcasting and a genuine martial-weapon proficiency grant; NEW one specified martial weapon proficiency is sufficient, without inventing proficiency with all martial weapons. For a spell you personally cast, one hand otherwise legally holding a weapon or shield may perform that spell’s S gestures while retaining that object. The hand and limb must still be capable of the required motion; restraints, missing anatomy or a feature explicitly forbidding gestures are not bypassed. NEW a buckler-occupied hand can use this same narrow S exception despite its ordinary lack of a free S hand. This gives no extra hands for loading, material manipulation, grappling, tools or wielding. A two-handed weapon can be held through the gestures, but its actual attack still requires its normal grip. F must independently be supplied by a legal focus; holding a sword does not make it a focus. V, priced/consumed materials, actual source access and nonproficient armor casting/concentration consequences remain. No advantage on concentration or Reaction spell is granted by this feat.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per beneficial SR/LR use an Action to create one of the three complete NEW seedling profiles below on visible supported ground within 30 ft and line of effect. It lasts one minute on original source-start markers, needs no concentration, and is a magical nonspell conjured body. Capacity is 1, or 2 at total level 10. NEW to make the second-capacity clause usable, at level 10 this same committed use permits one additional Action before the first plant expires to create one second plant; no second rest use, no later replacement of that spent creation. This is an explicit proposed addition to the printed one-seedling creation, not a recovered rule. Each plant gets its own minute. Choose its mode/burst type at creation. One BA may command all active plants within 60 ft able to perceive you, but produces only ONE selected mode outcome per round under the shared offensive-companion allowance. Lash chooses one creature within 10 ft of any participating plant for 1d6 piercing, DEX save half. Spore and entangle use their full profiles. No autonomous turn, opportunity attacks, harvest, loot, Supply, corpse or resource-generating death. Destruction/expiry permanently consumes the body.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Explicit NEW second Action at level 10 reconciles otherwise unusable capacity with once-rest creation; full bodies/modes and one coordinated offense.
submittedWorkedCases: Two active plants can extend where the single 1d6 lash originates; they do not produce 2d6 or two attacks.
At level 10, a second Action during the first plant’s lifetime can consume the one proposed additional-creation entitlement; it does not allow repeated replacement plants.

completeCurrentRecord.operationalRules:
Once per beneficial SR/LR use an Action to create one of the three complete NEW seedling profiles below on visible supported ground within 30 ft and line of effect. It lasts one minute on original source-start markers, needs no concentration, and is a magical nonspell conjured body. Capacity is 1, or 2 at total level 10. NEW second-capacity permission is the single original-use window defined by FLQ-02–03 below; it costs another Action, not another rest use. Each plant gets its own minute. Choose its mode/burst type at creation. One BA may command all active plants within 60 ft able to perceive you, but produces only ONE selected mode outcome per round under the shared offensive-companion allowance. Lash chooses one creature within 10 ft of any participating plant for 1d6 piercing, DEX save half. Spore and entangle use their full profiles. No autonomous turn, opportunity attacks, harvest, loot, Supply, corpse or resource-generating death. Destruction/expiry permanently consumes the body.
FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-04 — NEW split command/phase completion. On the owner's regular turn, first establish a legal shared Bonus Action, an available owner/numbered-round offensive-companion allowance, and actual receipt of the required within-60-ft audible or visible command by each nominated participating plant. At that legal commitment spend the Bonus Action and that one shared offensive allowance once; record the owner, original regular-turn/round identity, participating plant IDs, one chosen mode and target or area, its permitted origin or nominated Lash origins, and the immediately following attached phase. This is a paid pending command, not a Readied action, independent plant turn or extra allowance. It need not be the owner's last voluntary decision that turn. Resolve it once in the attached phase after that same regular turn's actual end processing, using the preserved schedule; an extra turn neither advances nor duplicates that phase. Recheck the surviving unended, unsuppressed, otherwise capable participating plant and the mode's actual target/area, range, perception and line-of-effect requirements. For Lash, an independently legal surviving nominated origin may support the same selected target; losing the selected Spore/Entangle origin does not authorize another origin or mode. For an area, resolve its actual occupants at that phase. If the chosen outcome is no longer legal, close the pending command with no effect, no refund, no new target and no carry to a later phase. After actual receipt, later owner incapacity, Silence, loss of owner-to-plant sight/range/channel, or owner death alone does not retract that command: no continuous concentration/channel/consciousness requirement is added. These states can prevent a NEW command or personal creation/Bloom Burst. An effect expressly cancelling the pending command or disabling/ending its plant still controls. Once committed, no other companion or armed trap can spend the same owner-round allowance, and the phase does not spend it a second time.
KEEP the already-operative SUP-07 floraBody/dc acquisition requirement: at acquisition permanently select and record one actual possessed spellcasting route as this feat's DC provider. Use DC 8 + current PB + that route's current casting-ability modifier; do not invent Wisdom, Spellcraft or another default. This source choice is separate from the later seedling mode/burst-type choice. Ownership initializes only the finite creation allowance and body capacity, with no plant, pending additional creation, command or active effect. All printed acquisition predicates and the actual earned feat opportunity remain required.
FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-01 — KEEP acquisition-only provider selection. A valid paid Conjure Flora acquisition permanently binds its actual qualifying personal casting route and the ability operand supplied by that route. Later loss, expiry, retraining-away or temporary unavailability of that casting grant does not by itself remove Conjure Flora, reselect its provider, prohibit an otherwise legal Flora creation/command/Bloom Burst, terminate an existing seedling or disable an already armed entry trap. Current prepared repertoire, renewable casting charges and RP are not new ongoing Flora prerequisites. This does not qualify a NEW feat acquisition through a grant that is actually gone; ACQ-03 still governs that separate snapshot. Flora is a magical nonspell feat, not a cast through the provider: a spell-only prohibition applies only to its actual scope, Silence still blocks an audible command, and an effect actually suppressing this feat, a plant, its magic or the required action applies under that effect's own rule. NEW explicit lost-provider representation: retain the original provider/ability binding and compute Flora DC as 8 + the owner's current lawful PB + the current modifier of that bound ability; no alternative route, Wisdom default, reconstructed casting entitlement or favorable old ability score is substituted. A missing or invalid original acquisition/provider record is not cured by this rule. Completed results are not recalculated, and existing body HP/save snapshots, deadlines, spent uses and ownership are not reset.
FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-02–03 — NEW second-creation window completion. Each legally completed first creation records one original use ID, its first-plant ID and that plant's original minute deadline, with at most one additional creation unspent. This is a bounded open-use record even when the owner is below total level 10; it is not another rest use or an immediately usable creation at that level. Admit a second creation only while that same first plant remains present and unended, before its original deadline, with the additional creation unspent, current total character level at least 10, actual free plant capacity, and every ordinary Action, ground, range, line-of-effect and use predicate satisfied. The level-10 condition is live at the additional Action, not snapshotted at first creation. Genuine advancement during that open window can make the existing unspent permission usable, but creates no body, charge, healing or new window. Destruction, uprooting, Bloom Burst consumption, expiry or another actual ending of the first plant permanently closes any unused additional-creation permission immediately; its old future deadline does not keep that permission alive. Suppression without an actual ending is not by itself an ending. A legal additional creation consumes that one permission and costs its own Action, but no second rest use; its own minute begins at its own creation. Once the second plant exists, ending the first does not shorten the second's independent deadline. No ended plant, spent permission, missed deadline, level change, recovery, new ID or subsequent body can reopen the old use. A later beneficial rest restores only the ordinary creation allowance under FS-06; a later first creation starts a genuinely new use.
FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-04 — NEW explicit owner/instance continuity. These particular one-minute, nonconcentration Flora bodies do not end merely because their owner is incapacitated or dies; retain the same owner, mode, actual body state, original deadline and no-resource restrictions. No recipient, ally, host, companion or replacement actor inherits control. A received pending command may resolve only at its already attached original phase under the split-command rule, even if the owner's live initiative slot is removed; preserve that one scheduled phase, not a new recurring independent turn. An already armed Trapcasting plant may perform its specified first-eligible-entry exception without a new owner Action/Reaction or remote command channel, even while its owner cannot act or is dead, but it still needs the actual qualifying entry, operative plant/trap, target legality and unspent same-owner numbered-round allowance. Incapacity/death neither refreshes that allowance nor rearms or moves the trap. Preserve the owner's last lawful PB/selected-ability state when its live actor view ends, applying any subsequently due source-defined changes; death is not a zero ability score, a new provider or a freeze of expiring modifiers. Use that continuing lawful record for later Flora DCs; a missing authoritative operand is an invalid/unestablished input, not permission to invent one. Lawful recovery continues the same history without replaying missed phases or refilling anything. Ending a generating plant still ends its own Poisoned/Restrained records immediately. A legally committed Bloom Burst binds its existing DC/type/area event, consumes its body before its one payload, and does not fail merely because that required consumption has occurred; it grants no other action to the ended body. Other independently applicable cancellation, suppression, condition, duration and target rules retain their own actual scope. No Animal Companion release/death rule or standard-companion movement/Dodge/attack is imported into these fixed Flora profiles.

FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: PB uses per completed LR; no mid-epoch refill fromPBgrowth. After one actual hostile spell event targeting/affecting you resolves, if you either succeeded on its real save OR received no positive resolved damage from that event, you may spend a Reaction/use to recover 1 RP up to your real maximum. NEW require meaningful unwilling opposition: harmless, allied, cooperative, self-authored or farming spells do not qualify. A spell attack that legally targeted you but missed, immunity, or complete prevention can satisfy the no-damage branch; temp HP absorption is damage and alone cannot. A failed save against a hostile nondamaging control spell still satisfies literal no-damage, but only if its result leaves you able to react. One grant per actual cast identity across later ticks/events; no fan-out or repeating-zone farm. Positive saved-against damage may qualify through success. Resolve full damage/control/death first; no ordinary Reaction at 0 HP. Decline before spending if noRPheadroom. This is recovery, not transfer from the attacker or a new pool.

Choose stat permanently at feat acquisition. Pay by ending that exact record before outcome; no refund or consumption of another source’s Bleed. Healing spends a NEW finite Hemocraft Reserve of 2×character level set only at beneficial LR, paying actual restored HP, no excess/copy/resource outputs. Reserve starts 0 on acquisition. No consuming historical/already-cured Bleed or staged victims. The record’s ordinary Medicine-ending DC is the same chosen feat DC; actual positive-potential magical healing ends eligible Bleed through the existing cure procedure.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: For each actual illusory creature/object you personally create, the first attack or interaction that would end that particular illusion’s existence instead delays only that ending until the current actual turn ends. NEW outside initiative use the end of the current canonical six-second window. It remains nonphysical and observers retain information already obtained; known illusions do not regain concealment, cover, belief or control. Losing required concentration, natural expiry, dispel, source death or another independent ending still ends it immediately. The feat does not postpone an observer’s ordinary Investigation check or direct physical proof unless that source’s actual rule specifically ends the illusion itself. At the deferred endpoint end the illusion as originally required; where the source only grants a disbelief test rather than termination, use its actual Investigation check/save at its printed timing, with no free new save type. Current Minor Illusion/Silent Image physical interaction reveals to observers but does not end the global image, so normally does not trigger this delay.

A caster that teleports away, becomes untargetable, incapacitates you, or kills you can leave no legal attack. Reaction spells qualify as real casts, but the attack does not itself repeat casting or grant a newReaction. Readied spells trigger at actual preparation/casting, not a second time on held release. The chosen mode adds no spell rank, RPdiscount, Action, concentration slot or second cast. Commit the point with the legal spell; a later miss, save, counter or interruption refunds neither. FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: For a spell you can actually cast through a legal ritual route, halve only the route’s additional ritual time, with resulting additional time at least 5 minutes; retain the base printed casting time in full. NEW measure the result in elapsed seconds and round up to the next whole second so fractions never shorten a required interval. An original 10 minute addition becomes 5 minutes, not half the whole cast. An original shorter addition is not increased: use min(original additional time, max(300, ceil(original/2))). This explicit non-worsening interpretation preserves the minimum for reductions without penalizing a preexisting faster route. Components, formula/repertoire, costs, concentration, helpers and interruptions remain. It grants no Ritual tag or access; the separate proposed Ritual Caster overlay needs its own approval. Apply this additional-time change before any separately legal group active-time adjustment, whose minimum rule remains.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Additional-time-only arithmetic, no worsening of already-shorter routes and second rounding.
submittedWorkedCases: A 1 Action base plus 10 minutes ritual addition becomes the same 1 Action base plus 5 minutes.
A source’s 2 minute special addition stays 2 minutes, and this feat creates no ritual permission.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt half the added ritual labor, not base cast time, with a non-worsening five-minute floor and explicit composition with Ritual Channeler.

originalSourceObject.effect: You gain +2 to initiative and advantage on concentration saves while holding a readied spell. Once per short rest, you may cast a spell of 2nd level or lower as a bonus action; if you do, you cannot take a reaction until the start of your next turn. When you roll initiative, you may bank one cantrip cast—release it on any later turn in the encounter without spending an action.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require INT 15 and (Arcane Calculus OR Temporal Theory). NEW resolve the grammatical scope as+2 initiative AND concentration-saveadvantage only while actually holding a readied spell; initiative is not recomputed later. Once SR/LR change an actually available normalActionspell of actualrank 0–2 to BA, paying every normal cost. From commitment until your next regular start you cannot commit anyReaction, even if the spell is countered; existing stacked Reactions finish. NEW release that cantrip once withoutAction on one of your later own regular turns in that encounter, retaining actual concentration until then; target legality rechecks at release. No extra cast/copy/proc at release.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Keep INT13orWIS13; choose one qualifying ability permanently as this feat’s casting ability. The current848ordinary-card scan finds no explicit Ritual tag in their preserved Core-source tag arrays; neither a familiar external spell name nor a class procedure called ritual proves such a tag. NEW proposed Ritual-tag overlay below explicitly supplies seven existing reviewed rank1payload placements: Detect Magic,Identify,Comprehend Languages,Alarm,Unseen Servant,Find Familiar andIllusory Script, each using its exact Wizard source placement solely to fix rank/school/effect provenance. This new tag is a separate candidate overlay and needs joint approval, including its effect on the actual Wizard Ritual Casting feature. It changes neither those spell effects nor their ordinary class membership.

NEW feat learning route: with an actual complete legitimate formula/text or a willing qualified teacher who genuinely knows the exact ritual, spend8active hours per rank and10gp per rank of real practice/writing materials to record it in your actual usable ritual book. Rank0, if ever separately admitted, uses one rank for this learning cost. A suitable blank book, ink/tools, language access and actual instructor/facility costs remain real. Study uses completed15-minute phases under the language/research clock; it is spell learning/copying, not ordinary research for Diligent Researcher’s discount. There is no random completion roll, free formula, duplicate-learning benefit or tradeXP. The feat grants no free starting ritual or physical book. Its maximum recorded/cast ritual rank is min(9,floor((total character level+1)/2)); this explicit feat-only gate grants no class advancement. The present proposed tag set has only rank1entries, and future entries need their own exact review.

To cast a legitimately learned recorded ritual, use its actual book and all components, spend its ordinary casting time plus ten actual minutes of uninterrupted active casting, and meet its complete targets/action-trigger rules. This route cannot complete during an encounter; interruption ends the attempt with real time and committed consumables spent. NEW maintain concentration during the long casting procedure, ending incompatible prior concentration at commitment; at resolution continue only the resulting spell’s own concentration if any. Do not choose a Reaction-triggered spell and manufacture its trigger through slow preparation. Ordinary rankRPprice and price-only surcharge are0; an expressly printed consumedRPconversion or other independent cost still applies and needs an actual pool. No ordinary Dissonance generation or vent, no Refrain addition/reset or history alteration, and no resource recovery from merely completing the casting time; a spell’s explicitly bounded actual effect remains its own effect. This follows the intended ordinary ritual separation rather than creating an at-will strain reset. Actual Counterspell eligibility, one-attempt-per-pending-cast guards, components and range apply. Source-specific per-rest limits remain. Other pending ritual feats cannot reduce this time or multiply output until their own interactions are decided.

FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q01 / FT84-WRITTEN-RITUAL-01 — scoped selection for Ritual Caster learning and Spell Scribe.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: the actual Ritual Caster written-learning route is an authorized spell-copying procedure when the learner personally uses an already complete, legitimately accessible written version of the exact eligible ritual, can actually use its language/notation, and records the learned ritual in the learner's real usable ritual book. The written source must supply the complete instruction, not merely a title, unfinished notes or text whose missing content must be taught. This predicate is about how the real work is done; the presence of a tutor does not disqualify otherwise genuine written copying, and writing lecture notes does not convert teacher-led learning into copying.
For that written-copy work, an actually acquired Spell Scribe halves the ordinary eight-active-hours-per-rank learning requirement; take the strongest eligible time factor once, then apply Spell Scribe's final whole-minute upward rounding. A current rank-one ritual therefore requires 240 active minutes. Retain every completed 15-minute learning phase and its governing interruption/final-remainder rule. No reading, comprehension, recording, rank, tag, consent, facility, tool or source requirement disappears. Diligent Researcher, Craftsman, Quick Ritualist and Ritual Channeler do not reduce this learning transaction. No new starting ritual or physical book, Wizard spellbook entitlement, ordinary scroll-production permission, check, trade XP or automatic class acquisition is granted.
Teacher-led learning without the qualifying complete written source remains 480 active minutes per rank. A later lawful switch to written-copy work can affect only actually remaining unworked learning at a completed phase boundary; log the old and new basis and retain all actual time/materials. Do not retroactively relabel completed teaching or an interrupted uncredited segment as discounted copying. Only one route credits each actual minute. Wizard Spell Scribing keeps its own legal-found-Wizard-spell/spellbook predicate and its own bill; merely being a Wizard or having the same physical book does not substitute its class route for this feat route. When two reductions genuinely cover the same procedure and material category, take the strongest once, not their product.
NEW LIMITED BILL COMPLETION: before claiming a material reduction, record the real ten-gp-per-rank practice/writing bill as actual stock quantities and identified categories; it is not a new currency-only substitute for materials. Ordinary blank writing stock, ordinary nonrare ink and ordinary practice supplies are discountable only when their actual source/provider identifies them as such. Rare inks and unique or specifically required components remain full quantity; copying rights, instructor/facility services, reusable tools and the separate blank book are not made discountable by calling them consumables. There is no universal numeric split of the ten gp. A stated mixed bill must retain its undiscounted total and each actual lot's identity, availability and legal precision. Apply Spell Scribe's 3/4 mundane factor separately from time; preserve divisible quantities, ceil required indivisible units once, and ceil the final actual purchase once to copper. Known protected items remain unchanged.
An unitemized or ambiguous bill has no justified material discount. The otherwise legal learner may still use the qualifying half-time route and supply the complete genuine undiscounted materials/bill; missing classification does not ban copying or its independent time benefit. Missing actual required materials still prevents work. No guessed rarity classification, refund for supplies already used, duplication of the source, free rare ink or teaching-cost waiver follows. Real consumption, deterioration and fees are recorded as they occur; interruption loses only its actual phase credit and actual resources, never refills stock.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once LR, NEW spend a Reaction when a hostile pending spell has selected you as its sole creature target, after ordinary cast interruptions but before its attack/save/effect resolution. It must be an actual single-target payload, not one target remaining from an area or multi-target mode. Roll an unmodifiedd 20;16–20 redirects, preserving this explicit 25%procedure over legacy 10%. On success choose a different legal creature under the original spell’s actual target restrictions, range/line measured from the original origin, personally perceived by you where necessary; the original caster remains owner and supplies all stats/choices. Recheck legality, then use fresh original attack/save procedure against that new target; nothing resolves against you. If no legal new target exists, or on 1–15, the spell continues against you with advantage on each actual initial save it requires; no save is invented for an attack/automatic spell. Use/Reaction remain spent. A redirected/reflected/copy packet cannot be redirected again by this family or Spell Reflection. Protected/self-only/source-specific exclusions remain.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: First identify an actually authorized copying procedure and the exact spell or scroll, legal source access, rank, language/notation, ability/tool requirements, facility and recipient record. Reduce only that actor's eligible copying active time to one half and mundane-material quantities to three quarters; rare inks and unique components are unchanged. NEW: apply the strongest eligible reduction separately to each time/material category, rather than multiplying overlapping reductions. Wizard Spell Scribing therefore supplies the same half-time factor and its better half-cost factor for its own qualifying copying; owning both gives neither quarter time nor a second material discount. Convert to minutes and round the final active time upward to a whole minute. For divisible mundane inputs retain exact quantities; for indivisible items round required remaining units upward; a listed aggregate gp expense rounds upward to the next cp. Separately identify rare/unique inputs before applying a discount to a mixed bill. No classification from absence: an unitemized ambiguous special-ink bill must be resolved by its source procedure before a discount is claimed. Level-up free additions remain free. Matrix preparation, reconstructing unknown text from memory, formula research and copying an ordinary craft formula are not spell/scroll copying. A usable scroll can be duplicated only under a separately authorized scroll-production procedure; the feat supplies no procedure or item effect.

FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q01 / FT84-WRITTEN-RITUAL-01 — scoped selection for Ritual Caster learning and Spell Scribe.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: the actual Ritual Caster written-learning route is an authorized spell-copying procedure when the learner personally uses an already complete, legitimately accessible written version of the exact eligible ritual, can actually use its language/notation, and records the learned ritual in the learner's real usable ritual book. The written source must supply the complete instruction, not merely a title, unfinished notes or text whose missing content must be taught. This predicate is about how the real work is done; the presence of a tutor does not disqualify otherwise genuine written copying, and writing lecture notes does not convert teacher-led learning into copying.
For that written-copy work, an actually acquired Spell Scribe halves the ordinary eight-active-hours-per-rank learning requirement; take the strongest eligible time factor once, then apply Spell Scribe's final whole-minute upward rounding. A current rank-one ritual therefore requires 240 active minutes. Retain every completed 15-minute learning phase and its governing interruption/final-remainder rule. No reading, comprehension, recording, rank, tag, consent, facility, tool or source requirement disappears. Diligent Researcher, Craftsman, Quick Ritualist and Ritual Channeler do not reduce this learning transaction. No new starting ritual or physical book, Wizard spellbook entitlement, ordinary scroll-production permission, check, trade XP or automatic class acquisition is granted.
Teacher-led learning without the qualifying complete written source remains 480 active minutes per rank. A later lawful switch to written-copy work can affect only actually remaining unworked learning at a completed phase boundary; log the old and new basis and retain all actual time/materials. Do not retroactively relabel completed teaching or an interrupted uncredited segment as discounted copying. Only one route credits each actual minute. Wizard Spell Scribing keeps its own legal-found-Wizard-spell/spellbook predicate and its own bill; merely being a Wizard or having the same physical book does not substitute its class route for this feat route. When two reductions genuinely cover the same procedure and material category, take the strongest once, not their product.
NEW LIMITED BILL COMPLETION: before claiming a material reduction, record the real ten-gp-per-rank practice/writing bill as actual stock quantities and identified categories; it is not a new currency-only substitute for materials. Ordinary blank writing stock, ordinary nonrare ink and ordinary practice supplies are discountable only when their actual source/provider identifies them as such. Rare inks and unique or specifically required components remain full quantity; copying rights, instructor/facility services, reusable tools and the separate blank book are not made discountable by calling them consumables. There is no universal numeric split of the ten gp. A stated mixed bill must retain its undiscounted total and each actual lot's identity, availability and legal precision. Apply Spell Scribe's 3/4 mundane factor separately from time; preserve divisible quantities, ceil required indivisible units once, and ceil the final actual purchase once to copper. Known protected items remain unchanged.
An unitemized or ambiguous bill has no justified material discount. The otherwise legal learner may still use the qualifying half-time route and supply the complete genuine undiscounted materials/bill; missing classification does not ban copying or its independent time benefit. Missing actual required materials still prevents work. No guessed rarity classification, refund for supplies already used, duplication of the source, free rare ink or teaching-cost waiver follows. Real consumption, deterioration and fees are recorded as they occur; interruption loses only its actual phase credit and actual resources, never refills stock.

FT84-Q01 / FT84-WRITTEN-RITUAL-01 — scoped selection for Ritual Caster learning and Spell Scribe.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: the actual Ritual Caster written-learning route is an authorized spell-copying procedure when the learner personally uses an already complete, legitimately accessible written version of the exact eligible ritual, can actually use its language/notation, and records the learned ritual in the learner's real usable ritual book. The written source must supply the complete instruction, not merely a title, unfinished notes or text whose missing content must be taught. This predicate is about how the real work is done; the presence of a tutor does not disqualify otherwise genuine written copying, and writing lecture notes does not convert teacher-led learning into copying.
For that written-copy work, an actually acquired Spell Scribe halves the ordinary eight-active-hours-per-rank learning requirement; take the strongest eligible time factor once, then apply Spell Scribe's final whole-minute upward rounding. A current rank-one ritual therefore requires 240 active minutes. Retain every completed 15-minute learning phase and its governing interruption/final-remainder rule. No reading, comprehension, recording, rank, tag, consent, facility, tool or source requirement disappears. Diligent Researcher, Craftsman, Quick Ritualist and Ritual Channeler do not reduce this learning transaction. No new starting ritual or physical book, Wizard spellbook entitlement, ordinary scroll-production permission, check, trade XP or automatic class acquisition is granted.
Teacher-led learning without the qualifying complete written source remains 480 active minutes per rank. A later lawful switch to written-copy work can affect only actually remaining unworked learning at a completed phase boundary; log the old and new basis and retain all actual time/materials. Do not retroactively relabel completed teaching or an interrupted uncredited segment as discounted copying. Only one route credits each actual minute. Wizard Spell Scribing keeps its own legal-found-Wizard-spell/spellbook predicate and its own bill; merely being a Wizard or having the same physical book does not substitute its class route for this feat route. When two reductions genuinely cover the same procedure and material category, take the strongest once, not their product.
NEW LIMITED BILL COMPLETION: before claiming a material reduction, record the real ten-gp-per-rank practice/writing bill as actual stock quantities and identified categories; it is not a new currency-only substitute for materials. Ordinary blank writing stock, ordinary nonrare ink and ordinary practice supplies are discountable only when their actual source/provider identifies them as such. Rare inks and unique or specifically required components remain full quantity; copying rights, instructor/facility services, reusable tools and the separate blank book are not made discountable by calling them consumables. There is no universal numeric split of the ten gp. A stated mixed bill must retain its undiscounted total and each actual lot's identity, availability and legal precision. Apply Spell Scribe's 3/4 mundane factor separately from time; preserve divisible quantities, ceil required indivisible units once, and ceil the final actual purchase once to copper. Known protected items remain unchanged.
An unitemized or ambiguous bill has no justified material discount. The otherwise legal learner may still use the qualifying half-time route and supply the complete genuine undiscounted materials/bill; missing classification does not ban copying or its independent time benefit. Missing actual required materials still prevents work. No guessed rarity classification, refund for supplies already used, duplication of the source, free rare ink or teaching-cost waiver follows. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW use the finite three-spell minor-buff table below: personally cast Guidance, Resistance or True Strike with yourself as the otherwise legal recipient. At its completion hold that entire one-use buff instead of receiving it normally; only one held record, replacing loses the old. Original costs, cast history and earlier deadline remain, with an additional deadline at your next future regular end. The next actual spell you commit consumes/attaches the record automatically, even if countered or unsuitable; no indefinite skipping. Guidance adds its one 1d4 only to one actual ability/task check made by that next spell, declared before rolling; Resistance adds its one 1d4 only to one actual concentration save maintaining that next spell; True Strike grants advantage only on that next spell’s first actual spell attack. They create no check/save/attack. The attachment expires at the original held deadline or actual spell end, whichever first, even if unused. Current one-bonus-die/advantage rules apply. A copied buff, borrowed duplicate or another Spellweave cannot be held; no duration/resource/HP/stat transfer or new cast.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Choose INT,WIS orCHA permanently for this feat. Learn the exact ordinary Mage Hand identity (`mage-hand`,Universal rank0), using a NEW feat route with that chosen casting ability. Waive only its V/Scomponents for casts through this feat; a genuinely added other requirement remains. It is a real cast with its actual Action,shared Refrain/strain and interruption eligibility; absence of V/Sdoes not itself grant invisibility or hide an observable manifestation. Keep the current LRXvisible hand,no creature/objectHP,concentration up to1minute,30-foot control range,10lb/1-foot-cube unattended-object capacity,10-foot movement per caster Action and cargo-release rules. It does not become the different Transmutation Magehand identity.

NEW explicit creature-shove exception: as the one manipulation of the creation Action or a later Action commanding this actual hand, you may move the hand up to its ordinary10feet along a visible unobstructed path and attempt to shove one visible Large-or-smaller creature within5feet of the hand and within30feet of you. The target makes STRsave against8+PB+your feat ability modifier. On failure choose before resolution to push it5feet directly away from you along a legal supported path, or knock itProne; on success neither. This replaces the ordinary physical opposed-Shove roll only for this feat; no body-size growth,damage,pull,grapple or extra attack. Actual forced-movement/Prone immunities and geometry apply. No free object manipulation accompanies the shove. Each attempt uses its own legal Action; extra Actions do not refresh other resources, and there is no Bonus Action or autonomous-hand turn. If range/path/concentration is lost, the hand cannot shove and its normal ending/release rules apply. It supplies no ordinary spell-component hand or attended-object theft.

A later shove command is an Action using the existing hand, not another cast and not free telepathic manipulation. A creature beyond30feet cannot be shoved by claiming the hand has a separate unrestricted reach.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual acquired spellcasting. You have advantage on CONsaving throws whose actual purpose is maintaining concentration on a spell you are sustaining. This includes a real damage-triggered concentration save or another explicit CONsave to retain that spell, and no other roll merely because losing it might later break concentration. Use the existing damage-event timing and one-save procedure; temporaryHP absorption and actual damage consequences retain their governing definitions. Ordinary nonproficient-armor disadvantage or another actual disadvantage cancels the advantage normally; neither produces additional dice. A source-specific flat concentration bonus such as the proposed Resilient Mind applies separately if genuinely eligible under its own rule. WoundCONsaves,death saves,ordinary Strain/Exhaustion saves and nonspell concentration checks do not qualify simply because this creature also casts spells. The sole printed effect grants no occupied-hand Spermission,Reaction spell,reaction attack,automatic success or second concentration slot.
